handoff: Approve: the stale gate waits for a sync while the story PR is unfetched, and open-pr refuses a merged PR, so a squash-merged story ends via remote.pr_merged with no second PR; e2e + unit proven. 1 minor doc note.

findings.title: pr_seen doc says decide never acts on it
findings.detail:
The doc comment on StoryFacts.pr_seen says 'Decide never acts on it (its effects need a fresh pr)'. packages/core/src/decide/story.ts:542 now reads pr_seen to hold the stale gate. That is a noop, not an effect, but the comment no longer says the whole thing.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Say decide reads it only to wait for a sync, never to emit an effect.
